# Lighting upgrades and auxiliary switches

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

Install a fuse block to manage multiple light circuits. [t905]

[Partial] Install a double pole double throw switch to control the lighting circuit. [t905]

Source a heated seat switch panel and upgrade its three original switches to five. [t1030]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

2. Mount rocker switches in the cab or door panel for independent control of lights.

## Tips & gotchas

- Use automotive wiring (like speaker wire) as it is more vibration resistant than house wiring. [t905]
- [Partial] Consider using Cat5 or Cat6 cable for switch runs, though note that 24-23 gauge may not handle high amperage alone. [t905]
- Upgrade the original three switches to five total by adding two more. [t1030]
- [Partial] Swap all OEM switches on the new panel to match the added ones for consistency. [t1030]

## Common mistakes

- [Partial] Mounting LEDs directly into a standard reflector bowl where the emission axis does not match, causing glare and reduced range. [t905]
